name: agent-workflow
description: Run agent-workflow multi-agent workflows (deep-review, deep-research, spec-review, impact-review, dynamic) from the conversation: launch, wait, inspect and stop runs through the agent-workflow MCP server.

hooks.command: d="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; [ -n "$d" ] || d=.; P="$AGENT_WORKFLOW_HOME"; [ -n "$P" ] || P="$HOME/.agent-workflow"; p=$(realpath "$d" 2>/dev/null) || p=""; h=""; [ -z "$p" ] || h=$(printf %s "$p" | (shasum -a 256 || sha256sum) 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-12); case "$h" in ????????????) ;; *) h="" ;; esac; if [ -n "$h" ]; then set -- "$(find "$P/projects" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -name "*-$h" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"; w="$1/.agent-workflow/workflows"; [ -d "$w" ] || exit 0; s="$1/.agent-workflow/notify-check/hook-claude-code.stamp"; [ -f "$s" ] && [ -z "$(find "$w" -name run.json -newer "$s" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)" ] && exit 0; fi; (cd "$d" && npx -y --package=@agwab/agent-workflow@0.1.0 agent-workflow notify-check --host claude-code --stamp hook-claude-code 2>/dev/null); exit 0

input=$(cat); printf '%s' "$input" | grep -Eq '"prompt"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"([[:space:]]|\\[nrt])*(/aw|/agent-workflow:aw)(([[:space:]]|\\[nrt])|")' || exit 0; printf '%s' "$input" | npx -y --package=@agwab/agent-workflow@0.1.0 agent-workflow host-command --host claude-code 2>/dev/null; exit 0

input=$(cat); printf '%s' "$input" | grep -Eq '"command_name"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"(aw|agent-workflow:aw)"' || exit 0; printf '%s' "$input" | npx -y --package=@agwab/agent-workflow@0.1.0 agent-workflow host-command --host claude-code 2>/dev/null; exit 0

monitors.name: run-completion
monitors.command: s="$CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID"; [ -n "$s" ] || exit 0; d="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; [ -n "$d" ] || d=.; P="$AGENT_WORKFLOW_HOME"; [ -n "$P" ] || P="$HOME/.agent-workflow"; p=$(realpath "$d" 2>/dev/null) || p=""; h=""; [ -z "$p" ] || h=$(printf %s "$p" | (shasum -a 256 || sha256sum) 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-12); case "$h" in ????????????) ;; *) h="" ;; esac; until [ -z "$h" ] || { set -- "$(find "$P/projects" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -name "*-$h" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"; [ -d "$1/.agent-workflow/workflows" ]; }; do kill -0 "$PPID" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; sleep 2; done; cd "$d" && exec npx -y --package=@agwab/agent-workflow@0.1.0 agent-workflow notify-check --follow --host claude-code --session "$s"
monitors.description: agent-workflow: a run this session started has finished
